rule: Width of every card manage_diagram creates on a capability map; it cannot be changed there
evidence: WG3 probes 18 Oct 2026: every card 200 px wide

rule: Height of a card with no footer and fewer than two list lines
evidence: WG3 probes

rule: A card with no footer is list_base plus list_line_height per list line tall (at least card_height)
evidence: WG3 probes: 2/3/5 lines give 112/138/190 px

rule: A card with a footer is footer_height plus list_line_height per list line tall
evidence: WG3 probes: 0/1/2/3 lines give 130/156/182/208 px

rule: Height a card gains per list line (card attribute)
evidence: WG3 probes

rule: Width of a text box (a heading) as manage_diagram creates it whatever its text; the text is centred in it and wraps
evidence: WG3 probes: every text box 120 x 80 px

rule: Height of a text box; its text is centred in it and is cut after about four lines
evidence: WG3 probes and the editor (14 px text on 16.8 px lines)

rule: Horizontal space between neighbouring columns of cards
evidence: Exemplar: 22 px between column boxes; more without boxes so columns read apart

rule: Columns on one row of the grid before the rest wrap to a new row; a capability continuing into a second column counts each
evidence: Six 240 px columns plus the legend fit the 2000 px canvas of a blank level

rule: Sub-capabilities stacked under one heading before the rest continue in the next column
evidence: Keeps a column under about 1100 px

rule: Vertical space between cards stacked under one heading
evidence: Exemplar: 10-14 px between boxes

rule: Vertical space before a sub-heading; the text box adds about 25 px of its own above the text so the visible gap is about 40 px and groups read apart
evidence: Text is centred in its 80 px box

rule: Vertical space between the drivers row and the grid; between rows of the grid; and between band rows
evidence: Exemplar: 24-26 px between containers; more without containers

rule: Space between a heading's text box and the first card under it; the text is centred in its 80 px box so the visible gap under two lines of heading is about 30 px
evidence: Editor: 14 px text on 16.8 px lines centred in the box

rule: Horizontal space between the legend column and the grid
evidence: Exemplar: 88 px

rule: Longest word a heading can hold; the text box is 120 px wide and does not break words (about 104 px of text)
evidence: Editor: a 17-letter lower-case word is 115 px

rule: Longest word a heading can hold in capitals; a top-level heading with a longer word keeps its own case
evidence: Editor: CONFIGURATION is 116 px and INTERDEPENDENCIES 152 px

rule: Top-level capability headings and section headings (drivers and legend) in capitals so they read above sub-headings; a text box cannot be bold or larger
evidence: Text boxes take plain text only

rule: Border of a top-level capability or band drawn as a card (one whose sub-capabilities are list lines or that has none)
evidence: Navy 2 px border used for emphasised boxes in the exemplar process maps

rule: Fill of such a card when it has no rating
evidence: Light tint so a category card reads as one

rule: Border of a rated card below the top level; fill comes from data/capability-ratings.csv
evidence: manage_diagram sets a navy border with any fill unless a border is sent

rule: Text of the heading over the driver cards
evidence: Exemplars

rule: Longest card title before the plan warns it will crowd the card (the card does not grow for its title)
evidence: Exemplar titles are 2-6 words; a 200 px card holds about three lines

rule: Longest heading before the plan warns its text box will cut it
evidence: A 120 x 80 px text box shows about four lines of 11-15 characters

rule: Longest footer before the plan warns (the card does not grow for its footer)
evidence: Exemplar footers are one sentence

rule: Most list lines on one card before the plan warns the card is getting long
evidence: Exemplar lists have 2-3
